subject.title: [Bug]: restart storm from telegram.retry.jitter type mismatch + misleading doctor SecretRef for Telegram token

question: After the linked jitter migration is fixed or replaced, should this broad issue be closed with the jitter fix or split into separate remaining Doctor SecretRef, CDP profile isolation, and multi-state-root diagnostics items?
rationale: Current main partially addresses restart and SecretRef diagnostics, but the report combines several operational branches that may need separate product/security ownership instead of one broad fix PR.

options.title: Land jitter, then split leftovers
options.body: Keep this issue open for the linked jitter migration, then open or link narrower follow-ups only for still-reproducible SecretRef/service-isolation branches.

options.title: Keep all branches together
options.body: Require one broader maintainer-sponsored fix plan that covers jitter, SecretRef diagnostics, restart behavior, CDP isolation, and multi-state-root warnings before closure.

options.title: Scope to jitter only
options.body: Declare the jitter crash loop the only remaining blocker here and ask new reports for any current SecretRef or service-isolation failures after the migration lands.

recommendation.title: Land jitter, then split leftovers
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the linked jitter migration, then open or link narrower follow-ups only for still-reproducible SecretRef/service-isolation branches.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans config compatibility, gateway stability, and issue-scope policy; the retry/config provenance points most strongly to this owner among the sampled history.
